answer: Escrow holds one share per identity per epoch. A submission carries a fresh nonce; replay of an old nonce is rejected and burns the escrow. At the nadir of a farm, 10,000 identities produce 10,000 nonces and 10,000 escrow locks, so capital at risk scales linearly with the fake count. One signal from the jury moves the score; the ridge between honest and forged narrows to the nonce cost.
